recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-14717 unless BR&R opens a new issue for additional PackagedProductDefinition narrative or editorial cleanup.
issue_request: FHIR-14717 was a Published/Persuasive BR&R issue from the STU3 ballot saying MedicinalProductPackaged had insufficient Description of Resource and Scope and Usage documentation and should not proceed until a resource proposal and explanation of how it relates to other medication resources were complete. Although the Jira resolution field still contains earlier defer text, the later 2019 comment, vote, Published workflow state, and Applied for Version R5 indicate the applied decision was substantial R5 improvement.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentions FHIR-14717. The application appears to have happened through the R5 medication-definition redesign: PackagedProductDefinition replaced MedicinalProductPackaged, fhir.ini keeps the old name as a redirect, and commits including d72f0cd65b0b and 9765a2c28472 replaced the original one-line packaging description with broader scope text and StructureDefinition source. Later PackagedProductDefinition commits refined the narrative and element definitions.
additional_context: The current build actively includes PackagedProductDefinition and maps MedicinalProductPackaged to it. Current Scope and Usage text explains packaged items, sale/supply/shipping/storage scope, packaged medications/devices/other items, package/packageFor relationships to MedicinalProductDefinition, contained usage, consistency of package aspects, and recursive package relationships. The Medication Definition module page explains relationships to MedicinalProductDefinition, Medication, ManufacturedItemDefinition, and package sizes. FMG approved the PackagedProductDefinition FHIR Resource Proposal on 2019-10-30, and later FHIR-29783 was resolved No Change because the wording had already been updated and balloted.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active successor resource already contains the documentation and relationship explanation requested by FHIR-14717, and adding more local prose for this issue would be redundant rather than corrective.

related_jiras.note: Later PackagedProductDefinition wording proposal resolved No Change because the wording had already been updated and balloted, supporting the conclusion that FHIR-14717's documentation concern is no longer outstanding.
